"The collapse of communism in the Soviet Union and Eastern Europe was followed by a painful transition from an authoritarian socialist system to a democratic capitalist system. The model of transition in Russia, Central Asia, and Eastern Europe, heavily influenced by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank, came to be known as 'Shock Therapy'.
